query: UPDATE email SET state='approved',planned_at=?1,latest_at=NULL,manual_schedule=0,error=NULL,updated_at=?1 WHERE id=?2 AND state IN ('failed','maybe_sent') AND (task_id IS NULL OR task_id IN (SELECT id FROM task WHERE state<>'stopped')) AND mentor_id IN (SELECT id FROM mentor WHERE trashed_at IS NULL) RETURNING task_id
